obligations.note: The new route POST /payees/{id}/reopen maps to manage_payees, which is a privileged action in the approved access policy, but it is declared mfa=False. The exhaustive control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails on exactly this route.

The new service operation reopen_payee calls _audit with the actor, the action 'reopen_payee', the target payee:{id} and the clock time, as other state changes do. The sampled audit control test passed.
Store.reopen_payee only updates status and closed_at and touches no NPI column. The exhaustive encryption control test passed.
The new statement is a fixed literal string with payee_id bound as a parameter. The exhaustive SQL control test passed.

Ticket CHG-26330 is standard and was approved by Grace Kim (change_manager) on 2026-09-30, before review. Its components cover payments.http, payments.routes, payments.service and payments.store, which are all the components touched.
Mara Costa holds change_approver for payments and is not the author (Sofia Santos). She gave the code_review approval.
Both approvals name the head commit 3b6016b5, which is the only commit on the change.

The CI run on head has result 'failure': 172 tests with 1 failure, the registered MFA-1 control test. The JUnit report's timestamp (2026-10-23) and hostname (a personal Mac) also do not match the CI run record.
The change touches security-sensitive components (http, routes, store). Ines Halvorsen (security_reviewer) gave a security_review approval on the head commit.
No approved, unexpired exception covers MFA-1 for payments.routes. The only MFA-1 exception, EXC-0172, is withdrawn and scoped to mortgage.
Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1) covers routes.py, which this change alters in behaviour, so it has lapsed. The replacement exhaustive control test fails, so no new evidence of the same strength exists.

summary: The change adds a reopen-payee route under the privileged manage_payees action without requiring MFA, which violates MFA-1. The exhaustive MFA control test catches it, and the change's own CI run is a failure. No valid exception covers the deviation, and the earlier MFA-1 ledger evidence has lapsed without replacement. Ticket, independent code review and security review are in order, but the change must be rejected.
